failure_modes: A pair-kernel or joint-RMS direction cannot be compiled because the executing pointcloud scalar has no such term; attempting to encode it via an allowed edit would be an unregistered substitution.

A regional or temporal edit chosen from non-monotone, low-fidelity landmark_00 curves would extrapolate beyond observed support and could displace surrounding coordinates without a validated affinity benefit.
Survival-based direction priorities are weakly identified given thin ancestral coverage and no BH-surviving survival field.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's most reproducible adjusted directions are short-range pair-distance shell density (pair_kernel_1.5/2.5, adjusted covariance q=0.077-0.081, adjusted correlation q=1.9e-2/4.0e-3, same-sign batch fraction 0.79-0.93) and negative joint innovation/internal RMS (adjusted correlation -0.150/-0.137, q<1e-3). However, the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit), so no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can express that direction. The remaining candidate levers are not defensibly supported: global centroid effects are non-significant and collapse under adjustment (branch_adjusted:0-2, 77-79); shape_yy is the only reproducible shape sign but is not addressable by any allowed edit; landmark_00 continuous contrasts are non-monotone with 4-10 sign changes and no accepted polynomial (continuous:0-9, curve_support), so a time-conditioned or regional edit would be extrapolation beyond observed support; survival enrichment is weak and no field survives BH at q<0.05 with thin ancestral coverage (349/700 nodes <3 ancestors, 531 <6). With decoded terminal learning labels unavailable, descendant credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit. Because no allowed edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent under the affinity-first objective, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; the incumbent's fixed temperatures (mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0) are preserved and no temperature edit is proposed.
